dialogues.jp: 「おまたせ――って、あれ？」
dialogues.en: "I'm here!! ......Huh?"
dialogues.text: "I'm here!! ......Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
いつもなら俺よりも先に来ている萌先輩の姿が
ない。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai's usually here before me, but she wasn't here.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai's usually here before me, but she wasn't here.

dialogues.jp: 「授業が延びてるのかな」
dialogues.en: "Maybe her class isn't finished yet."
dialogues.text: "Maybe her class isn't finished yet."

dialogues.jp: ぼんやりと屋上を歩きながら頭をかく。
dialogues.en: I walked across the rooftop and scratched my head.
dialogues.text: I walked across the rooftop and scratched my head.

dialogues.jp:
でも、水曜のこの時間の授業はいつも終わるの
が早いんだけどな。
dialogues.en: But her class usually lets out early on Wednesdays.
dialogues.text: But her class usually lets out early on Wednesdays.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、いいや。とりあえず、テーブルでも用意
　しておくか」
dialogues.en: "Oh well. I'll just prepare the table."
dialogues.text: "Oh well. I'll just prepare the table."

dialogues.jp: 「……来ないな」
dialogues.en: "......She's still not here."
dialogues.text: "......She's still not here."

dialogues.jp:
昼休みが始まってから、かれこれ１５分ぐらい
経つ。迎えに行ったほうがいいんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
It's been about 15 minutes since the lunch break started.
Should I go and get her?
dialogues.text:
It's been about 15 minutes since the lunch break started.
Should I go and get her?

dialogues.jp: なんか昨日、様子が変だったから……。
dialogues.en: She was acting strange yesterday......
dialogues.text: She was acting strange yesterday......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……すみません……遅くなってしまいま
　した……」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... I'm sorry...... I'm late......"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... I'm sorry...... I'm late......"

dialogues.jp:
屋上にやって来た萌先輩は、なにやら眠そうに
｛まぶた／瞼｝を｛こす／擦｝っている。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai finally came to the rooftop, scratching her
sleepy eyes.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai finally came to the rooftop, scratching her
sleepy eyes.

dialogues.jp:
「いえ。それにしても珍しいですね。この時間
　に遅れるなんて」
dialogues.en: "It's okay, but you're usually on time for lunch......"
dialogues.text: "It's okay, but you're usually on time for lunch......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい……ちょっと午前中に眠ってしまいまし
　た……」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... I fell asleep this morning......"
dialogues.text: "Yes...... I fell asleep this morning......"

dialogues.jp:
それでもまだ、トロンとした眠たげな表情をし
ている。
dialogues.en: She still looked sleepy.
dialogues.text: She still looked sleepy.

dialogues.jp: 「最近、眠そうですけど、どうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "You seem so sleepy lately, what happened?"
dialogues.text: "You seem so sleepy lately, what happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことないですよ。いつも通りです」
dialogues.en: "No I'm not. I'm the same as usual."
dialogues.text: "No I'm not. I'm the same as usual."

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑む萌先輩。確かに、まぁ、いつも
眠そうなのはいつも通りか。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai smiled at me. I guess she's always sleepy......
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai smiled at me. I guess she's always sleepy......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……どうぞ……」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... here you go......"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... here you go......"

dialogues.jp: 弁当の包みを手渡される。
dialogues.en: She passed me the lunchbox.
dialogues.text: She passed me the lunchbox.

dialogues.jp: 「えっ……あ、どうも」
dialogues.en: "What? Oh, thank you."
dialogues.text: "What? Oh, thank you."

dialogues.jp: 今日も萌先輩が食べさせてはくれないみたいだ。
dialogues.en: I assume she's not feeding me again today.
dialogues.text: I assume she's not feeding me again today.

dialogues.jp: 椅子に座り包みをほどく。
dialogues.en: I sat on the chair and opened the lunchbox.
dialogues.text: I sat on the chair and opened the lunchbox.

dialogues.jp: 「あの……今日、｛うち／家｝に来れるんですよね」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... You're coming to my house today, right?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... You're coming to my house today, right?"

dialogues.jp: いくぶん含みがちらつく言い方だったろうか。
dialogues.en: I hope the tone of my voice didn't sound like I have plans.
dialogues.text: I hope the tone of my voice didn't sound like I have plans.

dialogues.jp:
今日は部活がない日だし、家事をしにきてくれ
るはずだ。
dialogues.en:
She doesn't have the club meeting today, so she should be
coming to my home to do some chores.
dialogues.text:
She doesn't have the club meeting today, so she should be
coming to my home to do some chores.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい。今日は行けません……」
dialogues.en: After that, we'll go to our room and......
dialogues.text: After that, we'll go to our room and......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry. I can't go today......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry. I can't go today......"

dialogues.jp: 思わず声を上げてしまう。
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 「どうして？」
dialogues.en: I couldn't help but to ask.
dialogues.text: I couldn't help but to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「今日は、どうしても人と会わないといけない
　んです」
dialogues.en: "I have to see someone today."
dialogues.text: "I have to see someone today."

dialogues.jp: すまなさげに、でもハッキリと言う萌先輩。
dialogues.en: She spoke hesitantly but clearly.
dialogues.text: She spoke hesitantly but clearly.

dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうですか……残念……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, really? ......bummer......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, really? ......bummer......"

dialogues.jp:
出来るだけ気にしてないように微笑みながら、
心で泣くことにした。
dialogues.en:
I smiled to pretend I was fine, but I was crying inside my
heart.
dialogues.text:
I smiled to pretend I was fine, but I was crying inside my
heart.

dialogues.jp: くすん……。

かなり期待していただけに、お年頃の男の子と
しては悲しい。
dialogues.en: I was expecting a lot, so I felt pretty sad.
dialogues.text: I was expecting a lot, so I felt pretty sad.

dialogues.jp: コト――
テーブルの上に錠剤のビンが置かれる。
dialogues.en: At that moment, she put something on the table.
dialogues.text: At that moment, she put something on the table.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ、もう飲むんですか？」
dialogues.en: It was a bottle of pills.
dialogues.text: It was a bottle of pills.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい、今日はあまり食欲がないので……」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I don't have much of an appetite today......"
dialogues.text: "Yes. I don't have much of an appetite today......"

dialogues.jp: ｛ふた／蓋｝を開けて｛じょうざい／錠剤｝を｛てのひら／掌｝にのせる。
dialogues.en: She opened the lid and took out some pills.
dialogues.text: She opened the lid and took out some pills.

dialogues.en: (2 tablets?)
dialogues.text: (2 tablets?)

dialogues.jp: いつもの倍の薬を口に含み、飲み込む。
dialogues.en:
She took double the amount of what she usually takes, and
swallowed them.
dialogues.text:
She took double the amount of what she usually takes, and
swallowed them.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay?"

dialogues.jp:
そう言いつつ、テーブルにくたっ――と突っ伏
してしまう。
dialogues.en: She spoke and laid her head on the table.
dialogues.text: She spoke and laid her head on the table.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩？」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「スー」
寝てるし。
dialogues.en: She's asleep.
dialogues.text: She's asleep.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩ッ」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai!"

dialogues.jp: 肩をガクガクと揺するが起きる気配がない。
dialogues.en: I shook her shoulders but she wouldn't wake up.
dialogues.text: I shook her shoulders but she wouldn't wake up.

dialogues.jp: 「つーか、反応すらないし……」
dialogues.en: "She's not even reacting to me......"
dialogues.text: "She's not even reacting to me......"

dialogues.jp: ぐぅ〜。
とりあえず、萌先輩の弁当でも食べとくか。
dialogues.en: I'm just going to eat her lunch.
dialogues.text: I'm just going to eat her lunch.

dialogues.jp:
本来ふたりで食べるはずの弁当に、ひとりで箸
をつける。
dialogues.en: I started digging into our lunch all by myself.
dialogues.text: I started digging into our lunch all by myself.

dialogues.jp: また、萌先輩に食べさせてもらいたいや。
dialogues.en: I want her to feed me again.
dialogues.text: I want her to feed me again.

dialogues.jp: ◆錠剤◆
dialogues.en: ◆Pills◆
dialogues.text: ◆Pills◆

dialogues.jp:
普段より遅く、萌先輩がやって来た。やはり、
元気がない。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai showed up later than usual. She didn't seem well
again.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai showed up later than usual. She didn't seem well
again.

dialogues.jp:
俺の家に来て欲しかったのだが、萌先輩は人と
会うからと、それを断った。くすん……。
dialogues.en:
I wanted her to come over to my house, but she said she
needs to see someone today. Sob......
dialogues.text:
I wanted her to come over to my house, but she said she
needs to see someone today. Sob......

dialogues.jp:
今日、萌先輩が飲んだ錠剤は、いつもの２倍だっ
た。
dialogues.en: She took double the amount of pills today.
dialogues.text: She took double the amount of pills today.
